<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_SalesOrder" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/sales-order">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Inquiry" name="Product or service inquiry"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Quote" name="Quote"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_QuoteApproval" name="Quote approval"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_OrderConfirmation" name="Order confirmation"/>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_SalesOrder">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="Company" processRef="Process_Sales"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Inquiry" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="StartEvent_Inquiry"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Quote" sourceRef="Task_SendQuote" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_QuoteApproval" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Catch_QuoteApproved"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_OrderConfirmation" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Sales" name="Sales and Order Process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Inquiry" name="Inquiry received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Inquiry" messageRef="Message_Inquiry"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CollectInfo" name="Collect relevant customer information"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_AddressConcerns" name="Address concerns and questions"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Interested" name="Customer interested?" default="Flow_NotInterested"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_GuideSelection" name="Guide customer through product or service selection"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendQuote" name="Provide quote to customer" messageRef="Message_Quote"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_QuoteApproved" name="Quote approved by customer">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_QuoteApproval" messageRef="Message_QuoteApproval"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PlaceOrder" name="Place order"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_RecordOrder" name="Record order in system"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendConfirmation" name="Send order confirmation to customer" messageRef="Message_OrderConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_OrderConfirmed" name="Order placed and confirmed"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NotInterested" name="Customer not interested"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Inquiry" targetRef="Task_CollectInfo"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_CollectInfo" targetRef="Task_AddressConcerns"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_AddressConcerns" targetRef="Gateway_Interested"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Interested" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Interested" targetRef="Task_GuideSelection">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${customerInterested == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotInterested" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Interested" targetRef="End_NotInterested"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Task_GuideSelection" targetRef="Task_SendQuote"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_SendQuote" targetRef="Catch_QuoteApproved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Catch_QuoteApproved" targetRef="Task_PlaceOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrder" targetRef="Task_RecordOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_RecordOrder" targetRef="Task_SendConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="End_OrderConfirmed"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
